Background: Use case: illustration-story. ONE very simple production 2D health-bar BACKGROUND sprite for a cozy pastel cartoon tower defense game. Exactly one long horizontal rounded rectangle with aspect ratio 8:1, front view, centered on a square canvas with generous transparent space around it. Empty health-bar track ONLY, no colored health fill. Thin restrained muted warm-brown outer outline, pale ivory/cream rim, recessed warm gray-beige inner track. Slightly darker track so a green fill will contrast clearly. Border thin relative to bar height, small smooth rounded corners/endcaps. Flat friendly cartoon, 2 or 3 simple tones, subtle top highlight only. No fancy frame, no metal shine, no ornaments, no heart, no icon, no text, no numbers, no ticks, no segment dividers, no external drop shadow. Absolutely transparent background outside bar. It should read cleanly at a small on-character HP bar size. Bar width about 85 percent of canvas width, height one eighth of that width. One empty cream-framed horizontal track and nothing else, transparent PNG.
Fill: Use case: illustration-story. ONE very simple production 2D health-bar FILL sprite for a cozy pastel cartoon tower defense game. Exactly one long horizontal rounded rectangle with aspect ratio 8:1, front view, centered on a square canvas with generous transparent space around it. This sprite will receive red/yellow/green tint from Unity Image.color, so the ENTIRE sprite must use only NEUTRAL WHITE AND LIGHT GRAY, no hue at all. Pure white upper face, near-white main face, restrained light gray lower band (RGB around 220 to 255), two or three flat tones maximum. Opaque interior. Smooth subtly rounded ends. This is a neutral colorable health strip ONLY: NO outer frame, NO dark outline, NO gray background track, NO panel behind, NO heart, NO icon, NO text, NO numbers, NO segments, NO sheen glare, NO glow or external shadow. Absolutely TRANSPARENT background outside the strip, including all outer margins, not an opaque black/white/checkerboard canvas. Keep the fill shape consistently thick across its entire length. Bar width about 85 percent of canvas width, height one eighth of that width. One clean white/light gray fill strip and nothing else. Transparent PNG.
